newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica will not confirm reports of new director.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica will not confirm reports of new director.

text.p: Telefonica de Espana S.A. would not confirm reports on Tuesday that it is to name Fernando Abril as the company's new finance director.
"There is nothing official on that and we can neither confirm nor deny the report," a Telefonica spokesman said.

According to the daily El Pais, 35-year-old Abril, the head of treasury at JP Morgan in Spain, will replace Francisco Monchon as head of finance. Monchon was named head of international business at the group in the restructuring of the leadership at the end of November.
